'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 John Veasey LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Veasey]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room]]
* '''Username:''' VeeZ
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
